columns.name: inflow_baseline_usd

comment: Client operating cash flows derived from the payments hub, daily from 1-Apr-2024 to 30-Sep-2026, with the client's closing deposit balance (D13 record_type rows). record_type 'Flow': one row per golden client x date x cash-flow category (payment purpose: Supplier, Payroll, Tax, Intercompany, Loan Service, Dividend, Trade Settlement) with inflows (inbound payments), outflows (outbound) and net (inflow - outflow) in USD - flows, additive across days and categories. record_type 'Balance' (cashflow_category = Closing Balance): the client's total end-of-day deposits (CASA + TD) - daily from 1-Dec-2025 (the daily deposit window), month-ends only before - POINT-IN-TIME, never sum across dates (take the last date). record_type 'Month Total' (cashflow_category = Month Total, dated the month-end): one row per client and month, dense from its first cash-flow month to Sep-2026, with the month's inflows / outflows (0 when none) and the client's average monthly inflow (inflow_baseline_usd) - Seasonality Index = SUM(month_inflow_usd) / SUM(inflow_baseline_usd) and inflow volatility = stddev of month_inflow_usd over these rows. Each amount lives on its own record type only, so the measures never double count. Grain: one row per golden client x date x cash-flow category (payment purpose, Closing Balance or Month Total).
